text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the Sprinters Stakes with 
miraculous speed, K.S. Miracle achieved 
the spring-autumn sprint double. She had 
become the "fastest of her era"—the sprint 
king.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a captivating performance that 
completely transformed the spectators' 
perception of sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle is showered in blessings. She 
isn't just receiving miracles anymore— she 
has become someone who grants miracles to 
others.
